findings.text: The text claims that trigger bodies inherit the outer conflict algorithm, but `rowsKeys` initializes `RowFrame.algorithm` to `none`, so an outer `INSERT OR IGNORE` incorrectly aborts when a trigger inserts a duplicate key. Fix: Pass the outer algorithm into the initial frame and add a regression test before claiming this behavior.

No test covers trigger-only clock reads through `runSqlAt`, which currently classifies a trigger using `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` as clock-free and writes NULL even with a valid supplied clock. Fix: Add this regression test and include trigger expressions in statement clock detection.

The new body UPDATE path lacks a function-failure test and accepts `UPDATE log SET x=json(new.v)` with invalid JSON as a supported successful NULL write, whereas SQLite fails the statement. Fix: Check body assignment and filter faults over the combined table and trigger cells, and add a regression test that rejects this unsupported execution.
